subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline image rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from tool output, or should it render only trusted structured media-store/attachment references?
rationale: The feature crosses from tool/model text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, which is a product and security boundary choice that automation should not settle.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to consume current details.media/generated-attachment references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads from tool text.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep host path reads only with an explicit trusted-root policy, focused security tests, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical tracker
options.body: Leave the feature tracked in the canonical issue while this draft is rebased or replaced by a maintainer-sponsored implementation.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to consume current details.media/generated-attachment references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads from tool text.
